historical_comparison: Raw and HQR tail diagnostics use exactly the same disjoint C flow identities, not unequal historical sample sizes.
mixture_decomposition: At a fixed historical C threshold: change = supported-group mixture term + supported-group conditional-rate term + unsupported-group contribution. Identity independently checked to1e-12.
primary_metric_distinction: Mechanism decomposition is flow-weighted known rejection at fixed historical thresholds; it is not the primary mean-daily achieved FRR of the rolling policies.
causal_boundary: All mechanism evidence is descriptive association and arithmetic decomposition; neither identifies the cause of traffic shift nor proves causal mediation.
background_attribution: Actual primary decisions are disaggregated by true background group and predicted known service; both favorable and unfavorable changes retained.
